thread:
lina_sales: Quick heads-up — Orbit POC needs a final prompt stocktake + success criteria alignment. Can we get a tidy baseline prompt list and pass/fail evals by EOD Tuesday? Their answers to security/pricing block the kickoff. @omar_se @ben_pm

omar_se: Ack. I can trim the prompt list down to families. Do we want 6–8 canonical prompts (happy/edge/attack) or everything?

lina_sales: 6–8 canonical families is ideal. Customer cares most about: entity extraction (PII redaction), user intent classification, and reply generation quality for canned responses. Also they want latency target ~200ms p50 and cost guardrails.

ben_pm: For success criteria proposal: entity F1 >= 0.92, intent accuracy >= 0.94, generation relevance >= 0.88 (human eval), latency p95 < 500ms on dedicated; cost target < $0.003/token. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sofia_re: Sounds reasonable. I'll create an eval harness. I need sanitized example inputs for each prompt family (50 examples each ideally). Can we export from their sample dataset or synthesize?

lina_sales: Orbit gave a redacted CSV with 120 rows — I'll share a sanitized subset in the drive. If we need more, synthesize variants.

omar_se: Working on a compact baseline — quick snippet of planned prompt families (will share in thread):

```
1) REDACT_PERSONAL: extract & redact PII from free text
2) CLASSIFY_INTENT: map to 12 intents
3) SMART_REPLY_SHORT: generate 1–2 sentence reply from context
4) RANK_OPTIONS: rank candidate answers
5) FIELD_EXTRACT: extract structured fields (date, amount)
6) NEGATION_CASES: adversarial negation tests
```

ben_pm: Nice. For pricing conversation — callout that if they opt for Dedicated we can guarantee p95 SLO and a lower token price; hosted can still meet latency for small batch with caching but cost is higher. I'll draft a short pricing note.

anne_sre: Security checklist notes: Orbit will have SOC2 ask + retention windows. We need to confirm: (a) whether logs can be turned off for PII flows, (b) retention defaults, (c) KMS usage. I'll DM legal for standard wording.

lina_sales: Good — can everyone flag blockers by tomorrow noon? Specifically: dataset availability, final success thresholds, and security gating items. If any of those slip we push kickoff.

sofia_re: I'll start the eval harness today. Plan: automated metrics (precision/recall/F1), BLEU/ROUGE for generation, and a small human review (20 examples) for relevance. Will post initial dashboard link when ready.

omar_se: One more ask — can we pin a canonical prompt for SMART_REPLY_SHORT so results are reproducible? Example: "Given the user message and context, generate a concise professional reply in <=2 sentences. Do not invent facts." I'll add that to the repo.

devops_bot: deploy:eval-harness v0.3 started by @sofia_re — ETA ~18m. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1947632100

lina_sales: Thanks team — great momentum. I'll consolidate action items and send Orbit a recap after we collect blockers. :thumbsup:

ben_pm: I'll own the pricing note and share by EOD.

sofia_re: Starting dataset sanitization now. Will need 1–2 clarifying examples from Orbit for ambiguous intents.

omar_se: Will push the canonical prompt templates to the repo and tag them in the thread.
